display_name: Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS (AI Runtime Security)
auth_scheme: x-pan-token header (PANW_PRISMA_AIRS_API_KEY); NOT Authorization bearer -- vendor-specific header
install_tell: LiteLLM guardrail_hooks/panw_prisma_airs is the LARGEST guardrail hook in the catalog (84KB). Supports /v1/messages (Anthropic), /v1/responses, streaming-aware blocking. x-pan-token is the auth signal anchored on the API edge.
misconfig_patterns: x-pan-token leaked in proxy access logs or client-side intercepts; per-tenant scoping but no automatic rotation surface.
Streaming response handling blocks rather than scans for /v1/messages and /v1/responses raw SSE -- operators may interpret block as a service outage and disable the guardrail.
requester_metadata litellm_trace_id deep-copy for /v1/messages routes: cross-trace correlation surface.
deployment_tells: Distinct from Strata / Prisma Cloud SaaS; AIRS is its own product apex
Hook is by far the heaviest LiteLLM integration: streaming, Anthropic /v1/messages and OpenAI /v1/responses paths
